benchmark: SPHERIC Test 02 three-dimensional dam break with obstacle
notes: The geometry follows the official SPHERIC Test02/Kleefsman setup: water initially occupies x >= 1.992 m and height <= 0.55 m.
The structured mesh aligns tank and obstacle geometry while centering the top and gate free-surface cuts between mesh planes.
The obstacle is represented as an internal no-slip boundary in the background mesh.
The initial level-set field is negative inside the retained water column and remains negative on contacted tank walls.
The retained-column hydrostatic pressure is continued through dry cut-support vertices so the top trace is zero and the newly exposed vertical dam face retains its liquid-side initial trace.
The zero level set is limited to the top and gate-facing air-water interfaces; a closed-box signed distance incorrectly creates free-surface cuts on wet walls.
Earlier repository metadata used a 0.58 m retained column and swapped obstacle footprint; those settings are not the SPHERIC Test02 benchmark geometry.
Level set: harmonic PDE velocity extension, monolithic (D55), with kinematic reconciliation (D14), sign-definite patch bounds (D21) and triggered interface-preserving redistancing (D39).

The face files are disjoint (every face vertex on the wall or obstacle).  The June deck's files overlapped at the tank edges, and a face keeps the label of the last file listed: 94 faces of the top row of the side walls (left 12, right 12, front 35, back 35) carried the open wall_top label (no velocity condition) instead of no-slip; the other relabeled faces (between walls, and 16 obstacle faces next to the floor labeled bottom) kept a no-slip condition.

qualification_criteria.completion_justification: the front passes the obstacle and reaches the far wall well before 1 s; the June runs showed their pressure spikes in this window
qualification_criteria.front_speed_ratio_definition: measured over the 1.0 m from the gate to the H2 probe (x = 0.992 m): the experimental arrival time (H2 above 1 cm at 0.358 s) divided by the simulated one
qualification_criteria.maximum_sensor_pressure_justification: about 4.5 times the largest measured obstacle pressure (P1, 11.2 kPa at 0.415 s) and 9 times the column's hydrostatic pressure rho g H0 = 5.4 kPa; the June spikes reached MPa, so 50 kPa separates a spike from a physical impact pressure
qualification_criteria.minimum_front_speed_ratio_justification: the June front ran at 0.43 of the reference speed; 0.8 tolerates the coarse mesh (h = 0.08-0.10 m) while rejecting a front held back by the cut-cell treatment
qualification_criteria.reported: H2 and H4 heights and P1, P3, P5, P7 pressures against experiment (RMS); volume drift
qualification_criteria.status: proposal (D1): the working criteria of the SPHERIC campaign until the user sets tolerances
